label: mlx-lm
summary: Local model runtime: natural-language chores (digest, summarize, classify) run on this Mac through mlx_lm.server instead of a paid API.
why: Apple silicon only. The first server start downloads the configured model (about 4.5 GB for the default).

appliesWhen.note: MLX runs on Apple silicon only. On any other machine the local layer stays dormant and every caller falls back.

install.note: Isolated tool venv. Never plain pip: Homebrew's Python is externally managed (PEP 668).

verify.failsOn: The runtime is missing, or MLX cannot load on this machine.

uninstall: uv tool uninstall mlx-lm || pipx uninstall mlx-lm

drifts: the package name mlx-lm on PyPI

attribution.author: Apple (ml-explore)
attribution.notice: mlx-lm is open-source software from Apple's ml-explore project. cckit is not affiliated with Apple.
